Lots of people own dogs, and they become part of the family. Dogs are good companions, and they can be good at cheering people up. They mainly enjoy going for walks, playing and sleeping.

Cats are a different type of pet, but they are very cute as well. They enjoy sleeping and lazing around, but they don’t go for walks like dogs do. Cats also like to play with string and go outside.
